# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: evidence gaps

As of 2026-09-30.

## Links with no evidence

- `ln-cohorts-ties`: Peer-learning cohorts and coaching sessions delivered → Members form peer relationships across sizes
- `ln-ties-network`: Members form peer relationships across sizes → Members turn to each other for advice and joint work
- `ln-practice-capable`: Member leaders apply improved management practices → Member nonprofits run strong, well-managed organizations
- `ln-services-use`: Pooled service contracts and group purchasing deals in place → Members use pooled back-office services
- `ln-calendar-use`: Shared grants calendar published and kept current → Members consult the shared grants calendar when planning
- `ln-calendar-pipeline`: Members consult the shared grants calendar when planning → Members apply for more grants that fit their mission
- `ln-overhead-capable`: Members spend less staff time and money on back-office work → Member nonprofits run strong, well-managed organizations
- `ln-overhead-collab`: Members spend less staff time and money on back-office work → Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort
- `ln-overhead-sustain`: Members spend less staff time and money on back-office work → Members have diversified, stable funding
- `ln-pipeline-sustain`: Members apply for more grants that fit their mission → Members have diversified, stable funding
- `ln-briefings-know`: Policy briefings and joint-position drafts produced → Members understand local policy and funding processes
- `ln-know-positions`: Members understand local policy and funding processes → Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues
- `ln-ties-positions`: Members form peer relationships across sizes → Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues
- `ln-positions-collab`: Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues → Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort
- `ln-positions-voice`: Members adopt and share joint positions on local issues → Local government and funders consult members through a coordinated channel
- `ln-officials-voice`: Local officials and funders engage members in planning → Local government and funders consult members through a coordinated channel
- `ln-channel-officials`: A standing channel exists between members and the county planning office → Local officials and funders engage members in planning
- `ln-collab-access`: Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort → Residents get timely, good-quality services from local nonprofits
- `ln-sustain-access`: Members have diversified, stable funding → Residents get timely, good-quality services from local nonprofits
- `ln-voice-resvoice`: Local government and funders consult members through a coordinated channel → Residents' priorities shape local public decisions
- `ln-collab-resvoice`: Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort → Residents' priorities shape local public decisions
- `ln-collab-recruit`: Members routinely collaborate instead of duplicating effort → Members form peer relationships across sizes

## High-stakes assumptions with no evidence

None.
